dedupe_keys.name: kpx integrated energy use by administrative district electricity gas and heat use combined south korea

description: This Public Data Portal file from the Korea Power Exchange integrates energy use by administrative district across South Korea, combining data collected from KPX, the Korea Electric Power Corporation, the Korea District Heating Corporation and the Korea City Gas Association. Keywords on the record name electricity use, electricity trading volume, gas supply and heat sales, and describe it as combined, integrated data. The latest file covers data to 31 December 2024, has 2,904 rows, was modified on 9 December 2025 and is updated yearly, with the next release planned for 31 December 2026. It is a free CSV download, and the portal also serves it through an open API in JSON and XML after registration; the licence field states no restriction on use. Coverage is South Korea by administrative district. Caveats: the page read does not list the district level or the column definitions in the description, so users should check the column definition file, and heat and gas cover only the suppliers named. Simulation uses are spatial energy demand inputs for multi-energy system and district heating planning models. Related records: data-kpx-hourly-national-electricity-demand-korea gives the national hourly load.
